scope: Reference cases of the g4sim plan (Section 13): detector-specs reconstructed from cited claims of other profiles, each with its level of detail, cited claims, an independence result for its reference values, tolerances registered in the task card, a negative control and detection limit, and the label 'an approximate reconstruction from the cited claims, not the experiment's geometry'. S6: CMS ECAL barrel crystal (L1), AMS-02 TOF (L1), ePIC ZDC hadronic section (L2). S7: CMS ECAL barrel supermodule (L2) and crystal optics (L3), CMS Phase-1 barrel pixel and endcap CSCs, LHCb RICH radiators (L3) and SciFi, ePIC hpDIRC, dRICH aerogel (L3) and barrel TOF, AMS-02 TRD, tracker in the permanent magnet (a field map built from the magnet's published description, a parametrized approximation), RICH (L3) and ECAL.
exclusions: Claims of its own: every value is a claim of a profile it depends on
The experiments' own geometries: a case is an approximate reconstruction, and its comparison with cited values is validation, never confirmation
Private AMS-02 material: only the public experiment:ams-02 profile
The ePIC ZDC EM section, whose design is not settled
maintainer: hchouTW (public-document reference; not endorsed by any collaboration)

capabilities.name: geometry-reference-cases
capabilities.scope: Each case's detector-spec resolves every value to a claim of a profile it depends on, its case.json copies the task card's tolerances, and its quantities agree with their cited references within tolerance on E5 (Geant4 11.4.3) while its negative controls fail; not the truth of any claim, and not the experiments' geometry
